name: Punyo
def: Soft bodied humanoid upper body from the Toyota Research Institute that lifts large objects by hugging them with its arms and chest, not just its hands.
facts: Covered in air filled pads and a sweater like skin that sense pressure across the body
Built for research into whole body manipulation of bulky, heavy objects
